name: aurora-dia
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium modern Linux desktop wallpaper for an original open-source theme called Pomar.
Create exactly one finished full-bleed image, wide landscape 16:10 aspect ratio if supported, otherwise the widest landscape format available. Use the highest native resolution available.
Composition: elegant, soft, calm, smooth gradients, subtle depth, highly refined restrained design. Keep the top 12% quiet for a menu bar and the bottom 25% especially quiet and low-detail for a dock. Nothing busy in the center-bottom. The top and bottom quiet regions are natural continuations of the image, not bands, borders or empty overlays.
Original design only. Do not copy, reference or imitate any existing Apple wallpaper or recognizable branded wallpaper composition. No Apple logos or trademarks, no text, no letters, no logos of any kind, no watermark, no people, no devices, no UI, no mockup, no collage, no frames. Opaque image.

Primary request: LIGHT MODE abstract flowing translucent glass-like ribbons in pastel sky blue, peach and soft lilac over an almost white background. Gentle light from top-left.
Subject and composition: a small number of broad, graceful, softly curving translucent ribbons flowing horizontally across the middle and upper-middle, with smooth overlapping folds and delicate refraction. Loose open composition with generous breathing room, asymmetrical and organic. Their soft color dissipates into near-white toward the bottom. Glass has softly luminous edges and subtle depth, never sharp metallic highlights. Calm luminous pastel atmosphere.

Primary request: LIGHT MODE minimalist stylized orchard landscape at dawn: soft rolling hills with a few rounded abstract fruit trees, pastel pink/peach/blue sky, flat-with-soft-gradient illustration style.
Subject and composition: expansive pale blue sky blending very gently through lilac and pink to peach near the horizon. A few softly overlapping rolling hills, muted mint, pale blue and lavender. Just a handful of simple rounded abstract fruit trees distributed in small irregular groups along the middle-distance hills, subtly suggesting a tended orchard. Small unobtrusive fruit accents. Contemporary minimal illustration with softly dimensional gradients, simple pure silhouettes and quiet dawn light. No mountains, buildings, fences, paths or detailed vegetation.
